column2: [intro]
Mixed-up socks, chipped plates in sight,
We don’t care, it makes us laugh with delight.
Wrinkled papers, moved furniture in a heap,
That’s life, a joyful and wild sweep!
Mess up your home, let it be a sight,
Forget the rules and the lessons of right.
Let yourself go, do what you please,
Madness is the key to success with ease!
Hair in disarray, makeup dripping down,
We don’t mind, we’re free and unbound.
Torn pants, shoes untied and loose,
That’s our style, all chaos in use!
Mess up wherever you go,
Break conventions, let your spirit flow.
Dance on the tables, sing loud and free,
Let the chaos reign, it’s a jubilee!
[solo]
Mess up your home, let it be a sight,
Forget the rules and the lessons of right.
Let yourself go, do what you please,
Madness is the key to success with ease!
[outro]
